summary: Confirmed on KOA's campground page: full hookups to 50 A, 85-ft max length, pull-throughs, Wi-Fi, open year-round, reservable on KOA's form or by phone. Fees left (KOA booking form, human-read 2026-10-19: $123-235). Note: rates/RV Life/hookup lines dropped as structured.
